data_sources.description: Public-domain USDA product; citation requested. CropScape/CroplandCROS is an access interface, not a separate measurement. Programme began with partial-state coverage in 1997; complete CONUS coverage begins in 2008. No SPDX identifier is invented for the public-domain statement. GMU archive and newer native 10 m products are not conflated with the scoped USDA historical 30 m delivery. [Resource reconciliation: inventory rights and history] Inventory usage/citation statement (Amadeus data sources!I7): Public domain (USDA NASS); citation requested. Inventory source status (H7): Active; this is not observation QA, API availability or verified support for every product. Inventory first-release/history wording (J7): 1997. 1997 is programme start with partial coverage; 2008 is national coverage start. This profile pins native 30 m years 2008–2023; 2024 onward has native 10 m resolution.

products.name: cdl_usda_conus_30m_2008_2023
products.label: USDA CDL annual CONUS 30 m, 2008–2023
products.description: Annual national CONUS native 30 m USDA CDL class maps for map years 2008–2023 only. This profile excludes pre-2008 partial-state deliveries, Hawaii, native 10 m maps from 2024 onward, later 30 m resampled products, and separate confidence/cultivated/frequency layers. Use the matching YYYY_30m_cdls.zip national link for 2008–2023 on Product.access_url; retain the actual resolved file URL, map year and available revision/edition metadata. Annual editions are distinguished by map year; no common series-wide release/revision identifier is verified, so product_version is not fabricated. The historical direct 2023 URL used by the legacy downloader returned 404 during this review; the provider index links to /sites/default/files/Research_and_Science/Cropland/Release/datasets/. The new 2019 and 2023 links were inspected with HTTP byte ranges, not full science-array downloads. The original national world files for those two years verify 30 m pixels and matching pixel-centre origins; 2023 archive metadata supplies dimensions for that delivery only. Their TIFF directories lie outside the inspected prefixes, and all-year geometry invariance is unverified. The shared GridDefinition therefore retains verified NAD83 Albers EPSG:5070 and 30 m resolution only; common dimensions/origins remain unset. Read the acquired native header before any ROI windowing. Do not promote a state/processed subset or one annual header to the whole series. If a requested delivery genuinely has different CRS/resolution/geometry requirements, first verify it and link an appropriate existing or distinct grid/product rather than overwrite this shared definition. Map labels are nominal crop/non-crop classes, not yields, percentages or QA-confidence values. Map year describes harvest/growing-season classification, not a uniform daily observation interval. Keep native EPSG:5070 distinct from Annual NLCD WGS84 Albers. See cropscape_review_20261110/README.md for original archive metadata, world files, legend scopes and verification limits. [Resource reconciliation: inventory completeness] Amadeus data sources!N7 describes CONUS coverage from 2008 and earlier partial states; it does not establish per-pixel validity or fill observation gaps.
products.spatial_extent_descriptor: Contiguous United States, national coverage from 2008

canonical_variables.name: usda_cdl_crop_land_cover_class
canonical_variables.label: USDA CDL crop/land-cover class
canonical_variables.standard_name_authority: AMADEUS project-local semantic identifier; no ontology equivalence asserted
canonical_variables.description: CDL crop and non-crop legend; not interchangeable with NLCD categories or Köppen climate classes. Year/state-specific legends must be retained.

product_variables.quality_flag_vocabulary: Categorical CDL class legend, not an observation-quality flag or confidence score. Verified common examples in the retained USDA 2019 North Carolina and inspected archive reference tables: 0 = Background; 1 = Corn; 5 = Soybeans; 81 = Clouds/No Data; 88 = Nonag/Undefined; 111 = Open Water. Complete extracted source tables and their scope are in cropscape_review_20261110/legend_tables.json. Use the legend matching the acquired year/state/national delivery; a generic bundled reference table is not proof that each listed code occurs or has the same role in every annual delivery. The 2019 archive generic reference lists 171/181 while its separate NC 2019 legend and the 2023 reference use 176; do not silently substitute those reference tables for the acquired layer legend.
product_variables.harmonization_note: Read one nominal class band from the exact national 30 m 2008–2023 delivery and preserve the original map year, class codes and associated legend. Background 0 follows the verified provider legend and remains the declared missing sentinel; the processed fixture sentinel -2147483648 is not native evidence. Code 81 means Clouds/No Data in the inspected legends, not an ordinary unclassified crop or proof of crop absence. Preserve source codes for provenance and explicitly mask/report unavailable classes according to the acquired legend and analysis policy. Do not mask valid non-crop classes such as Open Water merely because they are not crops, or reinterpret Nonag/Undefined as a measured crop absence. Use class-preserving nearest-neighbour lookup/resampling when warping nominal codes; bilinear/cubic interpolation and arithmetic means of labels are invalid. For polygon class fractions specify valid-class/missingness handling and the denominator (valid observed area versus full target area); class proportions are not confidence scores. Inspect original CRS, pixel size, array dimensions and georeferencing before ROI processing; do not derive national origins from state metadata or the regional processed fixture. No executable QA mask, invariant all-year geometry, or native-code correction is implied by this descriptive contract.
